exp_note: The parenthetical number is Exophase's EXP (a per-trophy rarity score), NOT an earner count. Evidence: the kit's competition.yaml states each trophy's rarity is printed as '1.10% (570.00)' (percent to 2 decimals, then Exophase's EXP). It is a deterministic decreasing function of the rate (same rate -> same EXP: all 0.01% trophies show 7329.00, all 0.02% show 7257.00), and it is inconsistent with earners under any single players denominator (id 2 at 100% shows 73.00 while id 3 at 7.99% shows 823.00). EXP is recorded here for reference only; the forecast model must NOT use it (the case files do not carry it).

players_tracked_lower_bound_reasoning: Derived, not observed. The platinum (id 1) printed 0.63% = 4 earners of 638 players in the practice history (2026-11-19T02:30Z). Earners are cumulative, so it still has >= 4 earners. The live page prints 0.00% for it, i.e. a true rate < 0.005% under round-half-up (or < 0.01% under truncation). 4 / P < 0.00005 gives P > 80,000 (P > 40,000 even under truncation). So the tracked player base has grown at least ~125x since launch night (638) and ~20x since the first refresh (3,868). This bound is conditional on the 4 launch-night platinum earners still being counted; if Exophase's tracked set churns, the bound weakens, but the direction (massive growth) is unambiguous from the rate dilution alone.
